hypothesis: Original Stage1 predecision features plus its current own-state cap gap and risk state can distinguish whether a fixed 0.10 beta cap release has positive fee-net one-step value, beyond a constant training-mean receiver. This is a new action-value target, not a rerun of closed H5 cash or relative-return heads.
parent_boundary: Saved 2018-2022 original-architecture OOF 0bp Tiered reference supplies development labels. Frozen complete f696+b472 Stage1 own-state 0bp account remains the only later economic parent; SOXX is the hard gate.

features.availability: All original39 source feature_available_at no later than original 09:46 decision; cap gap and risk_state are saved own-state predecision fields. Their values are from original reference, so a changed future account may have different state.

target: Saved 0bp IBKR Tiered same-start cap+0.10 versus original next-session common-reset local_fee_net_advantage; ineligible/last unknown rows remain on full Qlib 1061-day calendar.

cohorts.train: Eligible local labels whose label_available_at is strictly before 2021-01-01T00:00:00 America/New_York, with trade_date in 2018-2020.
cohorts.evaluation: 2021-01-01 through 2022-12-30 trade dates with finite mature labels; fit frozen at 2021 cutoff, no 2022 refit.

receiver.candidate: One SimpleImputer(median)->StandardScaler()->Ridge(alpha=10.0) on the 41 frozen feature columns; one fit before evaluation.
receiver.control: Training-label arithmetic mean, held constant over both evaluation years.
receiver.predictions: Continuous local value; no sign threshold or action mapping in this card.

bootstrap.calendar: All 2021-2022 Qlib sessions, ineligible rows retained as zero paired-loss contribution and mask; resampled statistic divides by scored count.

stop: If source hashes/NAS, feature order/timing, 2021 maturity cutoff, 1061-day Qlib calendar, minimum train/year support, DatasetH alignment or Recorder identity fail, stop before fitting. After one fit and one fixed bootstrap, any information-gate failure closes this fixed receiver version; no sign, year, threshold, feature, alpha or window rescue. A passing information screen only authorizes a separately frozen complete Stage1-parent own-state 0bp candidate account, never SOXX promotion.
